g.text: Analytical workflow for SLC25A13 detection and nested family-grouped evaluation of an exploratory LoF/Mis classifier
Specimens and proteomic data
60 DBS: 16 LoF/LoF; 7 LoF/Mis (5 families, 2 sibling pairs); 10 carriers (parents of LoF/LoF
patients); 6 healthy adults; 21 disease controls; 3 analytical runs
DIA-NN 2.2.0 (1 % FDR, cross-run normalization): 7,474 protein groups → 5,199 with ≥ 3 unique
peptides (technical filter, applied once, not cross-validated)
Zero = not quantified; quantified values log2-transformed and ACTB-centred per specimen (Stage 2)
Stage 1 — Direct SLC25A13 detection (Fig. 2)
Rule: no SLC25A13-assigned precursor passing DIA-NN identification in the raw, non-imputed
data (peptides shared with SLC25A12 not counted)
Observed: not detected in 16/16 LoF/LoF; quantified in 44/44 others — a cohort-level
observation, not an independently validated rule
Carriers 0.35×, LoF/Mis 0.28× the median of the 27 non-carrier controls (healthy + disease)

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #404040

g.text: SLC25A13 quantified → Stage 2 analysis set
Stage 2 — Exploratory multiprotein classification (Fig. 3)
44 specimens, 35 families: 7 LoF/Mis vs 37 controls (carriers, healthy, disease controls);
Run 2 n = 9 (controls only), Run 3 n = 35 (all 7 LoF/Mis)
Classifier preprocessing, feature selection, fitting and threshold calibration restricted to
each outer training partition (right); panel size 30 fixed, inherited from same-cohort exploration
Internal out-of-fold evaluation of the model-development procedure (44 specimens, 35 families)
Computed once from the 44 held-out predictions (Table 2, Fig. 3): AUC, sensitivity, specificity,
balanced accuracy, Brier score, positive families detected
Primary consensus-30 ensemble: AUC 0.834 (95 % CI 0.602–0.971), sensitivity 7/7,
specificity 31/37, 5/5 families detected
CI: family-cluster bootstrap of saved predictions (no refitting) or exact binomial (specimen-level)
Two-stage evaluation of all 60 (Stage 1 observed, Stage 2 out-of-fold): retrospective, neither
stage independently validated (Table S16)
Sensitivity and reference analyses (Tables S10, S13–S15)
Nested refitting (single models, 10 seeds): panel size chosen in the inner loop (5–50);
training-only mean-only batch adjustment; Run 3 only (n = 35); family-level subsampling;
ensemble re-run after excluding PRL, MTTP, ARHGEF10 and SEC31A, individually and jointly
Post hoc, from saved out-of-fold predictions: LoF/Mis vs carriers / disease controls /
age-restricted controls; family-level performance; selection recurrence over 35 panels
Reference: 100 family-structured label permutations of the complete score-generation
procedure of the primary ensemble (inner threshold calibration omitted); P = (b + 1)/(N + 1)
Frozen research ensemble — trained once on all 44 development specimens
One 30-protein consensus panel; 10 coefficient vectors + intercepts; member-specific
preprocessing constants and imputation seeds; training-derived thresholds 0.034 / 0.210
Not independently validated; not evaluated on the 44 development specimens;
application to the 16 LoF/LoF (parents among the 44) is descriptive
Specification: Table S17 (machine-readable with the analysis code); LoF/LoF application: Table S18
Nested family-held-out cross-validation (one of 35 outer iterations)
Outer training partition (all families except the held-out family)
(i) MinProb imputation (q = 0.01) from training specimens only
(ii) no batch correction beyond DIA-NN cross-run normalization
(iii) 10 members (fixed seeds): stability selection on 30 class-stratified 80 % subsamples
(≥ 3 positives each), 1,000 highest-variance proteins per subsample, class-weighted
elastic net (α = 0.5) → selection-frequency ranking
(iv) panel size fixed at 30
(v) consensus panel = 30 proteins most often in members' top 30 (ties: mean frequency);
each member: standardize (training μ, σ) → elastic net, λ by family-grouped 3-fold CV
(vi) ensemble probability = mean of 10 member probabilities
Inner training set (all other families of the outer partition): steps (i)–(vi) → inner model
Inner held-out family → inner out-of-fold scores
(vii) Calibration on the inner out-of-fold scores
primary threshold: minimum inner score among positive specimens
secondary threshold: max. inner sensitivity s.t. specificity ≥ 0.90 (ties: fewer FP, lower τ)
adaptive strategy: consensus or diverse panel, whichever has fewer inner FP at the
primary threshold (ties: inner AUC, then consensus)

g.text: Inner family-LOFO calibration (34 folds; within the outer training partition): thresholds and adaptive strategy
Held-out family (excluded from all fold-specific fitting and calibration)
impute from the specimen's own 1 % quantile with training σ → standardize (training μ, σ)
→ mean of 10 member probabilities → call at the fold's threshold = one out-of-fold prediction

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3c7a3a

g.text: Outer loop (35 iterations, one per family)
Ensemble strategies (fixed before the final run)
primary: consensus panel; secondary "diverse": each member keeps its own top 30;
secondary "adaptive": chosen per fold in the inner loop (vii)
label-free data handling / study design
estimated from the outer training partition only
held-out family
evaluation / reported output
frozen final model
LoF, loss-of-function; Mis, missense; LOFO, leave-one-family-out; CV, cross-validation; FP, false positives; MinProb, left-censored imputation at the 1 % quantile.
